What happens when you ask ChatGPT to redesign a room in your house like a professional designer?

I tried this and the results actually blew me away.

Prompt 1:
Upload a photo of your living room or bedroom and say: “Here’s a photo of my room. Redesign it like a professional interior designer would. Keep the same basic furniture, but show me how it could look way better with different furniture, a different layout, colors, lighting, and decor. Make it warm, modern, and realistic.”

ChatGPT generates multiple images and hands you back a full professional redesign of that exact room.

Bonus prompt (this is what makes it actually useful):
Stay in the same chat and say: “Now give me everything in this new design on a budget of under $500 and include the exact Amazon links to each piece of furniture and decor you added.”

ChatGPT hands you a full shopping list with real links so you can actually build the room instead of just dreaming about it.

media.transcript: When it comes to owning a home, we all know there's always another project to be done. Another space to make cozy, more finishing touches to be added. And for us right now, that is our informal and formal dining rooms. Last year, we added shades to our boys' rooms from two pages, and I absolutely fell in love with the way that they completed each space. They were so easy to install and turned out beautiful. And they're exactly what we need to complete our dining room, starting with our informal dining room. I used that mock-up to finalize our designs with floor-to-ceiling sheer curtains, as well as Roman shades on each window. Curtain shades and rods all customized from two pages. I cannot wait to see how it turns out. Next is the formal dining room with floor-to-ceiling sheer curtains and rods again. Adding a little plate wall for a fun pop of decor. But I did decide to mix the Roman shades. I love that two pages makes it so easy to measure precisely for each curtain and shade with step-by-step directions. For a take, that is, because this was definitely on his honey-do list. Not to mention not a fraction of the price of other competitors. And now I just can't wait to share how it all turns out.
